description: This file contains the source code for the Affiliate model class in the OpenCart admin module, specifically managing affiliate-related data such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving affiliate information and reports.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Represents the Affiliate model class that handles operations related to affiliates including CRUD operations and reports within the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Adds a new affiliate record with provided data.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Updates an existing affiliate identified by customer_id with new data.

methods.name: editBalance
methods.description: Updates the balance of a specific affiliate identified by customer_id.

methods.name: deleteAffiliate
methods.description: Deletes the affiliate record and associated reports for the specified customer_id.

methods.name: getAffiliate
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about an affiliate by customer_id, including custom fields.

methods.name: getAffiliateByTracking
methods.description: Fetches affiliate details using a tracking code.

methods.name: getAffiliates
methods.description: Retrieves a list of affiliates with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAffiliates
methods.description: Returns the total count of affiliates matching optional filters.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves report entries for a specific affiliate with pagination.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all reports associated with a given customer_id.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Calculates the total number of reports for a specific affiliate.
